title: Koh Young Technology: True 3D SPI and AOI Metrology for Advanced Packaging
summary: An engineering review of Koh Young Technology's True 3D SPI and AOI metrology platforms featured in SMT Today Magazine Issue 80. Covers phase-shift moiré profilometry, 0.5 micron Z-resolution, <10% Gage R&R, AI warpage compensation, and IPC-CFX closed-loop process control.

distribution.linkedin_post: How do you achieve <10% Gage R&R and 0.5 µm Z-axis resolution on shiny solder micro-bumps? In SMT Today Magazine Issue 80, Koh Young Technology details its True 3D phase-shift moiré profilometry and AI warpage compensation for advanced packaging and SMT lines. Check out our full technical review: https://www.smtinsider.com/reviews/koh-young-3d-spi-aoi-metrology-review #SMT #Inspection #3DAOI #3DSPI #ElectronicsManufacturing #QualityControl
distribution.forum_answer: Specular reflections on shiny solder joints and WLP micro-bumps often blind conventional 2D AOI cameras. According to engineering data in SMT Today Issue 80, Koh Young's True 3D architecture avoids this via multi-angle phase-shift moiré profilometry, maintaining 0.5 µm height resolution and <10% Gage R&R while filtering false calls caused by PCB warpage using local Z-zero datums.
